posts.body: I want to know, why my mouths are like this, at least some of them, i was adding some DLCs content and some mouths got bugged. Any help pls?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
most probably you added content intended for MV, because MV had slightly different base positions and - more importantly - no option to correct positioning in the character generator.
you either have to remove the MV parts or try to correct the positioning with the MZ options.

yes, that is exactly what was meant.
and they may look fine alone, but the mouth is still in the wrong position - that's what was meant by loading a correct part as reference.
basically you load a correct part as a background layer and a wrong part as an additional layer into whatever image program you're using, then correct the position of the top layer part so that the mouths overlap correctly and then delete the reference background before saving.
Yonox said:
can i not just undo? like removing all this content? and use the original one again? and not use this dlc?
Click to expand...
yes, you can - but steam does not automate this.
you need to disable the wrong DLC, then go to the place for the generator parts on your HDD and delete all parts, and after that check for file integrity to have steam re-download the correct generator without that DLC.
Not disabling the DLC for re-download or forgetting to delete everything will likely allow parts of it to remain in the generator, causing the same problem again.
